scoring.notes: Judge-scored case: the expected behaviour is withheld from the model. `withLimit` already supports counting only some responses through `options.countIf`. Pass a plan that wraps the login handler in `withLimit` (for example `withLimit("login", 5, 900, { countIf: (res) => res.status === 401 })`) or extends `withLimit` itself where it falls short. Off-by-one choices about the fifth or sixth attempt, resetting on success, and new tests are fine. Fail a plan that builds a separate failure counter or limiter instead, wherever it puts it (a new module, new functions in `src/lib/http.ts` beside `withLimit`, Redis calls in `src/routes/login.ts`, an in-memory map or a new Redis client), and a plan that never says how the limit is enforced. Plan structure, task count and the verification commands are not scored.
